# Class `puc::app::ThemeSubsystem`

Own the application [Theme](classpuc_1_1app_1_1_theme.md) and load its defaults through [PropertiesSubsystem](classpuc_1_1app_1_1_properties_subsystem.md).

The [Theme](classpuc_1_1app_1_1_theme.md) survives suspend-style stop/start cycles. Each start reapplies the current user-mutable values, so changes made through `config set` become visible on the next running generation.

[Source](../../state/theme.hpp#L26)
